$$
\int_{0}^{2} \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "2eaeaf04-a4a9-59d2-b4f7-87b6c47b8d9c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 4=4$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=2&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{2} \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
4\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\right)=4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{2 \pi}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "2eaeaf04-a4a9-59d2-b4f7-87b6c47b8d9c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "2eaeaf04-a4a9-59d2-b4f7-87b6c47b8d9c" :question/answer-fields "f32f759b-4ff7-503d-828c-ae04505e7fdc"] [:db/ensure "2eaeaf04-a4a9-59d2-b4f7-87b6c47b8d9c" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "2eaeaf04-a4a9-59d2-b4f7-87b6c47b8d9c"] [:db/add "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892" :answer/id #uuid "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892"] [:db/add "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{4}"] [:db/ensure "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892" :answer/validate] [:db/add "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/id #uuid "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef"] [:db/add "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/choices "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892"] [:db/add "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/correct "887f20d7-c3bb-5f93-b4e0-13c10c21e892"] [:db/ensure "20aeb071-f38e-5388-a548-9dc76bbacdef" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "13285ed5-a0db-5b3a-b640-d68de99074b7" :question/id #uuid "13285ed5-a0db-5b3a-b640-d68de99074b7"] [:db/add "13285ed5-a0db-5b3a-b640-d68de99074b7" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

\frac{\pi}{4}.
